from.place: The finite Koszul model of derived completion in def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback; Tag 0A0E identifies the negative finite complex with the dual of the positive one. This node isolates splitting off the first exterior koszul generator. This node isolates bijectivity of graded head-tail exterior multiplication.

title: Bijectivity of graded head-tail exterior multiplication
statement: For every commutative ring A, natural r,m, coefficient list a : Fin(r+1) to A and integer i, the explicitly constructed map koszulJoinGraded of [def-weil-pbc-koszul-join-graded] is bijective in degree i. Its source is the degree-i coproduct of the tensor of the rank-one and rank-r exterior cochain complexes for the head and tail of a, with exponent m+1, and its target is degree i of the rank-(r+1) complex for a, with the same exponent. This assertion concerns only the graded modules, with no choice of complex isomorphism and no differential or power-transition equation.

source.place: Tag 0664, lemma-join-sequences-koszul-complex, proof hint: exterior generators of the two factors and their Koszul differentials.

proof.text: If i>0, both the target and every tensor summand are zero by extension-by-zero, so the positive-degree bijectivity theorem applies.
If i≤0, bijectivity is the ordered head-tail exterior basis decomposition, isolated in the nonpositive-degree theorem.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0664; grading split into positive zero terms and nonpositive ordered-subset basis decomposition.
